title: Client reel for Shivam Arora (@venomstech)

pieces.text: ye jo aap video dekh rahe ho … meri poori reel
aur dikhaye usmein badhiya graphics … wapas le jaaye
aur iske baad main bolun … bhai saab bye
ab ye sab kuch aap bhi kar sakte ho bahut aasaan hai
aapko apne claude ko … convert karna hai
ab iski ek bana rakhi … dm nahi jaayega
aur bhai aap apni editing … karwa sakte ho
ab obviously ai hai … zyada lagega ya kam
wo main bataunga uske liye follow kar lena
ab iski bana rakhi … subscribe kar lo

notes: Delivered 2026-10-21 (see VERIFY.md). Ported from edit/edl.py + timeline.json. compose_base.py holds the frame-by-frame effects (paper cut, text-behind, his reel sliding in) until step 5 moves them into the catalog.
